interface.shortDescription: Auditable statements, ratios, valuation and filing adapters.
interface.longDescription: Build provenance-rich fundamental, idea-funnel, research-review and sell-side consensus-challenge contracts; compare company filings and dated expectations; keep investor flows separate from disclosed ownership; and calculate transparent operating metrics without hard dependencies.
defaultPrompt: Build an auditable fundamental review for this listed company.
Trace this theme or stock move into evidence-backed follow-on ideas.
Audit this research for management delivery, thesis drift and critical-number errors.
Compare these two annual reports and FY27 consensus snapshots.
Check Taiwan institutional flows separately from disclosed ownership.
Challenge the shared sell-side thesis on this listed company.
